# Farlish Studio

> High-Converting Modern Web Design & Development Agency for Small Businesses, Local Contractors, and Startups.

Farlish Studio builds high-performance, conversion-engineered websites that turn curious visitors into paying clients. Utilizing modern frameworks including Framer, Webflow, and custom code (HTML5/Tailwind/Next.js), Farlish Studio delivers agency-grade digital experiences in 2–4 days at transparent small-business rates starting at $399.

## Core Services

- [Custom Web Design](https://farlish.com/#services): Bespoke UI/UX design tailored for brand identity and high conversion rates.
- [High-Converting Landing Pages](https://farlish.com/#services): Conversion-rate-optimized (CRO) single-page funnels engineered for paid ads and organic discovery.
- [Small Business & Contractor Websites](https://farlish.com/#portfolio): Full multi-page web presence for home services, medical, legal, and local trades.
- [E-Commerce & Booking Platforms](https://farlish.com/#pricing): Storefronts, appointment scheduling, and payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Calendly, PayPal).
- [SEO & Speed Optimization](https://farlish.com/#services): 95+ Google PageSpeed scores, multi-entity schema markup, and Google Search Console indexing.

## Pricing Packages (Transparent, All-Inclusive & Fixed)

- **Starter Launch ($399 USD)**: Single high-converting landing page, 2–4 days delivery, 100% responsive, lead capture form, WhatsApp integration, plus **FREE Professional Copywriting ($189 value)** and **FREE Google SEO Setup ($149 value)** included.
- **Standard Business ($799 USD)**: 3 to 5 custom pages, 5–7 days delivery, interactive project cost estimator, local SEO schema, Google reviews integration, visual CMS dashboard, plus **FREE Multi-Page Copywriting ($289 value)** and **FREE Google Maps profile setup ($199 value)** included.
- **Growth & Store ($1,499 USD)**: Full multi-page platform or e-commerce store, 10–14 days delivery, Stripe/PayPal payment gateway & booking workflows, product catalog setup, store copywriting, and 60-day VIP priority support.

## Key Differentiators

- **All-Inclusive Value**: Unlike agencies charging extra for every word and tag, Farlish Studio bundles custom design, conversion copywriting, and local SEO free in every build.
- **Lightning-Fast Turnaround**: Delivered in days (2–7 days), not months.
- **Transparent Rates**: Fixed pricing starting at $399 without the standard $5,000+ agency markup.
- **Risk-Free Guarantees**: 100% Money-back satisfaction guarantee and $50/day on-time delivery credit.
- **US Focus & Global Reach**: Engineered specifically for United States small businesses, local contractors, and global startups.
